name: placement-assistant
description: Placement Assistant - AI Career Launchpad with Node/Express/PostgreSQL backend & Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
